caseName: Liberty Mut. Ins. Co. v. Carrizo Oil & Gas, Inc.
caseNameFull: LIBERTY MUTUAL INSURANCE COMPANY, dba Liberty International Underwriters v. CARRIZO OIL & GAS, INCORPORATED.

opinions.text: Motion of American Institute of Marine Underwriters for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.
